title: More Colors for Kids! Purple, Pink, Brown and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're meeting five more color friends.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: it's the color of grapes! Can you guess?
This is Purple! Can you say purple?
Grapes are purple. Plums can be purple too!
Can you pick pretend grapes? Pick, pick!
Can you guess which two colors mix to make purple?
Red and blue! Mix them, and you get purple.
Purple is a fancy, fun color.
Here's a clue: it's the color of many flowers! Can you guess?
This is Pink! Can you say pink?
Flowers and cupcakes can be pink!
Can you smell a pretend flower? Sniff!
Can you guess which two colors mix to make pink?
Red and white! Mix them, and you get pink.
Here's a clue: it's the color of tree trunks and teddy bears! Can you guess?
This is Brown! Can you say brown?
Teddy bears and tree trunks are brown!
Can you give a teddy bear hug?
Can you guess? What color is a tree trunk?
Lots of dirt and wood is brown.
Here's a clue: it's the color of rainy clouds and elephants! Can you guess?
This is Gray! Can you say gray?
Rain clouds and rocks are gray!
Can you stomp like a big gray elephant?
Can you guess which two colors mix to make gray?
Black and white! Mix them, and you get gray.
Here's a clue: it's the color of the night sky! Can you guess?
This is Black! Can you say black?
Tires are black. Some piano keys are black!
Can you play a pretend piano? Plink, plink!
Can you guess? What color are car tires?
Black makes bright colors stand out.

outro: Which color was your favorite today? Keep looking for colors and shapes everywhere you go.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
